Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Ltd. has informed the Exchange that Glenmark Pharmaceuticals S.A. (Switzerland), a wholly owned subsidiary of Glenmark Pharmaceuticals India (GPL) has received USD 10 million from Forest Laboratories (Ireland) in Q2-FY2005. This constitutes the upfront payment under the recently concluded collaboration agreement for Glenmark's PDE4 inhibitor GRC 3886 between the two parties. GRC 3886 is Glenmarks' novel, orally available PDE4 inhibitor in development for Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disorder (COPD) and Asthama, and may also have utility in other conditions. Under the landmark collaboration agreement announced a few weeks ago, Forest will develop, register and commercialize GRC 3886 for the North American market, while Glenmark will retain commercialization rights for the rest of the world. Glenmark can receive up to USD 190 million before commercial launch of the molecule in North America.
